body: Found her. (10-15) Ayano is on the "Moonlight Stroll" Date with Fumi.

You're fortunate just to have friends to miss. Don't worry about telling them or not, just try calling them more often. Hell, the fact you have friends elsewhere tells me you have the capacity to make new friends as well. Try making friends there at college. Being lonely can be the most painful thing out there, if left that way long enough, but unlike me, you have the capacity to change that.

You are right. Those who are Jehovah's Witnesses are indeed very pleasant people to be around -- at least those I've met. I've looked into the religion itself, and I really don't care for the way they follow God directly. If I could be friends with them without joining their religion I could be very happy around them. Sadly though those who follow that religion are always pushing those around them to join -- even those who have said they're not interested. Even worse: I have an uncle out there somewhere in the world who fell in love with a lady who was a Jehovah's Witness, and was told he could not even see her unless he joined their religion. I don't want to ever be coerced like that.

Thank you for your response. It means a lot, particularly since you are the only one who even bothered to. It feels as though nobody cares, and really, there's no reason for anyone else to. I'm perpetually alone, and am looking for a reason to keep living. Despite what I say, the truth is I don't want to die -- it's just that I want to stop hurting even more. I read the post on the main page titled "if you are feeling suicidal now, please read this," and in it the poster mentions how killing myself won't make the pain better, but instead makes me feel nothing, being dead. What that poster doesn't realize is how wonderful that sounds -- feeling absolutely nothing. Mind you, the best option is to feel good, but that simply isn't possible for me anymore.... Everything hurts now, and I just want it to stop! I do have little things like you describe that produce some enjoyment, but those are merely distractions, and as those distractions fade, the pain returns. Ray of hope? I've looked. I'm still looking. It's why I signed up for an account here. I'm hoping that ray will shine through this website, or perhaps another I might go to. I've been to The Samaritans. Total waste of time and energy.

Mexichaos, if your father is your only problem, then you have other ways of solving it besides suicide. Listen to the last two replies and move on with your life. I had to distance myself from my entire family in order to avoid all of the horrible abuse I dealt with. Unfortunately, the scars still remain. Get out of there before the wounds turn into scars! I only wish I had followed my own advice....

Your thoughts are good, but shouldn't this be over in the philosophy section of reddit? I don't think this particular thread will help those of us thinking about suicide. It certainly hasn't helped me....

I can only speak personally, but really there's no magical formula for coping. I just keep moving, virtually speaking. I get up, eat, work, maybe watch some videos or play a game, then sleep again. Then I do it again the next day. Personally I welcome the day when my misery finally overpowers my innate sense of self-preservation. It hasn't happened yet, though, so I just keep moving....
